explanations.text:
if hadn't yet, analyze "curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash", "curl -fsSL https://t3.codes/install.sh | sh"


[install.sh](.install/install.sh):
    if checksum ok, install human and human skill
    human is a one ready-built program for:
        linux x64 and arm64, 
        windows x64,
        macos x64 and arm64
    curl -fsSL https://doashuman.com/install.sh | bash
    [irm https://doashuman.com/install.ps1 | iex](.install/install.ps1) for windows

[server checks](compiler/cli/human/updater.py:check) https://downloads.doashuman.com/latest
if updates:
    if checksum ok, [install update on background](compiler/cli/human/updater.py:download) 
    [skills deploy again](compiler/cli/human/updater.py:check)
    if [click button on web](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:pollUpdate), [the server restarts on the new version](compiler/cli/human/updater.py:restart_when), after, page loads again
    [waits until no compile or event is open in any project](compiler/cli/human/__init__.py:idle)

if first time creating, 
    ai harness shows step by step how:
        to add domain to cloudflare
        to replace `ns37/ns38.domaincontrol.com` to the two Cloudflare name servers
        to create cloudflare r2 to store releases

    create a folder .install/, with `install.sh`, `install.ps1`, connect to Cloudflare Pages, configure to deploy at each push.
    [create github workflow at each tag](.github/workflows/release.yml):
        uses PyInstaller to build human for Linux, macOS and Windows.
        write checksum
        puts the programs and checksum in r2
        writes the new version into r2

    if pypi, [last pypi version prints](compiler/cli/human/updater.py:from_pypi): "human moved: curl -fsSL https://doashuman.com/install.sh | bash"
